q: The logistic map f₄(x)=4x(1-x) on [0,1] with the arcsine invariant measure is:
opts: Mixing and conjugate to the doubling map via x=sin²(πθ/2)
exp: The substitution x=sin²(πθ/2) conjugates f₄ to the doubling map θ↦2θ mod 1. Under the arcsine measure dμ=dx/π√(x(1-x)), f₄ is a Bernoulli shift — fully chaotic, mixing at all orders.
